query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage a GitHub repository workflow: authenticate, inspect organization/repository access, create and label pull requests, inspect CI and workflow logs, merge approved changes, dispatch build/deploy/destroy workflows, and troubleshoot deployment failures.
query_ground_truth.intent: Merge a pull request that has successfully passed review and CI checks.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if pull request identifier is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find the target pull request using BITBUCKET_LIST_PULL_REQUESTS (disambiguate by title and source/destination branches).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Fetch pull request details using BITBUCKET_GET_PULL_REQUEST (confirm it is open and intended for merge).
[Optional (if merges are gated on checks)] [Prerequisite]: Review build/status checks using BITBUCKET_GET_REPOSITORIES_PULLREQUESTS_STATUSES (ensure required statuses are passing).
[Optional (if approval is required before merge)] [Prerequisite]: Record approval using BITBUCKET_APPROVE_PULL_REQUEST (only if you have permission and approval is needed).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm merge strategy, merge message, and whether to close the source branch before write actions.
[Required] [Step]: Merge the pull request using BITBUCKET_MERGE_PULL_REQUEST (apply the confirmed strategy/message/close-source-branch choice).
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Re-fetch using BITBUCKET_GET_PULL_REQUEST (confirm the pull request is in a merged state).

[Optional (if merge fails)] [Fallback]: Re-check BITBUCKET_GET_PULL_REQUEST and BITBUCKET_GET_REPOSITORIES_PULLREQUESTS_STATUSES (identify conflicts, non-mergeable state, failing/pending checks, or missing approvals).
known_pitfalls: [BITBUCKET_MERGE_PULL_REQUEST] Merge may fail if the pull request becomes non-mergeable (e.g., conflicts) between validation and the merge attempt.
[BITBUCKET_GET_REPOSITORIES_PULLREQUESTS_STATUSES] Required statuses can be pending/failing and block merges until they pass.
[BITBUCKET_APPROVE_PULL_REQUEST] Approval can be a no-op or rejected if already approved or if the actor lacks required permission.
[BITBUCKET_GET_PULL_REQUEST] Similar open pull requests can be mistaken for the target; verify source/destination branches before merging.
[BITBUCKET_MERGE_PULL_REQUEST] Success details may be nested under data.merged_pull_request; don’t assume merged state is at the top level.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Bitbucket is a Git-based code hosting and collaboration platform supporting private and public repositories, enabling teams to manage and review code through pull requests and integrations
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=bitbucket. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="bitbucket") to create a connection BEFORE executing any bitbucket tools.

BITBUCKET_APPROVE_PULL_REQUEST.description: Tool to approve a pull request as the authenticated user. Use when you need to formally approve changes in a pull request review process.

pull_request_id.description: The ID of the pull request to approve.

BITBUCKET_MERGE_PULL_REQUEST.description: Tool to merge a Bitbucket Cloud pull request via the REST API. Use when you need to complete a PR merge after approval and checks pass. Supports custom merge messages, merge strategies, and source branch deletion.

message.description: Custom merge commit message. If not provided, Bitbucket generates a default message.

merge_strategy.description: Merge strategy to use. Common values include 'merge_commit', 'squash', 'fast_forward'. If not specified, uses the repository's default merge strategy.

pull_request_id.description: The ID of the pull request to merge.

close_source_branch.description: Whether to close the source branch after merging. If not specified, uses the repository's default setting.

BITBUCKET_GET_PULL_REQUEST.description: Get a single pull request by ID with complete details.

workspace.description: Workspace ID or slug (URL-friendly name). Must exactly match the pull request's workspace (case-sensitive); slug and UUID are not interchangeable.

pull_request_id.description: The ID of the pull request to retrieve.
